verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only surfaces for external AI tools: an Environments MCP server for clients like Claude Code and Cursor, AI-readable docs meant for third-party chatbots, and credential delivery to AI agents. None of these is an in-product assistant a user can delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
